close_reason: Removed redundant id injection from process_create in submission.rs; matches identity.rs pattern
description: process_create (line 822-832 of submission.rs) still manually re-injects server_id into the serialized obj_json after calling create_object. identity.rs was cleaned up (JMAP-ptl.9) to rely on the create_object contract guaranteeing the returned object has its id set. submission.rs should be consistent. — Remove the if let Value::Object block; rely on the same contract as identity.rs.
title: submission.rs process_create: redundant id injection after create_object
